purpose: Bind one evidence-qualified Campaign V3 residual branch to one explicit Git-persisted RehydrationLoop V1 without treating campaign coordination as scheduler execution authority.
preconditions: binding expected Git head equals compilation/current campaign Git head
any candidate required_operation remains actually exposed at binding time
campaign_id/branch_id/expected_campaign_digest identify the current campaign lease target
transaction: record post-lease Git head and new campaign digest
require campaign lease commit to advance Git head
start RehydrationLoop V1 with expected_git_head = post-lease Git head
bind campaign branch to exact loop identity/state through current campaign digest
record post-bind Git head and binding receipt

git_address_law.reason: campaign lease itself is durable causal Git state; reusing the compilation/pre-lease head would be stale

failure_recovery.loop_start_failure_after_lease: HOLD_LOOP_START_FAILED; branch remains leased and requires explicit release/recovery
failure_recovery.campaign_bind_failure_after_loop_start: HOLD_CAMPAIGN_BIND_FAILED; reuse/rebind existing loop after fresh resume; duplicate loop start forbidden

compatibility.campaign_api: internal requalified RehydrationCampaignRuntime methods; no public campaign dispatcher required
compatibility.method_parameter_adaptation: narrow signature adapter permits harmless historical parameter naming differences but requires all semantic slots

non_goals: execute the campaign task during binding
turn campaign lease into execution permission
claim task success from loop creation
